Self-hosted reading tools by **felixapel**. Bookwarden remains documented in the repository README as a separate project; there is no validated Unraid one-click template for its Certificate A release.
### 🌐 Book Translator Hub Bilingual LLM translation overlay for stock [Calibre-Web Automated](https://github.com/crocodilestick/Calibre-Web-Automated). Read CWA through the translator's proxy port and translate EPUB chapters in place with a local OpenAI-compatible LLM, using your existing CWA login. * **Template:** `book-translator-hub.xml` (image pinned by digest) * **WebUI (reader proxy):** http://[IP]:8385/ * **Repository:** [GitHub](https://github.com/felixapel/book-translator-hub)
**Support:** * Book Translator Hub: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/felixapel/book-translator-hub/issues) * Contact: felixguillermoapel@gmail.com
